title: Terreno
location: Caldas da Rainha - Nossa Senhora do Pópulo, Coto e São Gregório, Caldas da Rainha, Leiria
description:
Lote de terreno de 1.115m2 c/ uma área bruta de construção de 1.000m2 e com bons acessos. 

Com viabilidade para construção de 28 fogos.

Excelente localização na cidade de Caldas da Rainha, junto a escolas, parque desportivo, comércio e a dois minutos do acesso à A8. 

A poucos minutos da praia da Foz do Arelho e de São Martinho do Porto. A cerca de 45 minutos do aeroporto de Lisboa.

Ótimo investimento, com possibilidade de permuta.

 Plot of land of 1,115m2 with a gross building area of 1,000m2 and with good access.

 With feasibility of building 28 homes.

Excellent location in the city of Caldas da Rainha, close to schools, sports park, commerce and two minutes from the access to the A8.

A few minutes from the beach at Foz do Arelho and São Martinho do Porto. About 45 minutes from Lisbon airport.

Great investment.

The city of Caldas da Rainha is located north of Lisbon (93.5 km via the A8) and southwest of Coimbra (128 km via the A1 / IC36 / A8).

A place to visit is the Praça da República (popularly known as "Praça da Fruta"), held every day, in the morning, in the open air, the only daily fruit and vegetable market in the country, practically unchanged since the end of the nineteenth century.

Even today, the city of Caldas da Rainha keeps as arms the coat of arms of Queen D. Leonor, flanked on the left by its own emblem (the shrimp tree) and on the right by the emblem of D. João II (the pelican). By keeping these weapons, the city is one of the few villages in the country to use a coat of arms prior to the normalization of municipal heraldry carried out in the mid-twentieth century, which is not in accordance with current legislation.
